## Details

<a id="sfx_sample_knockdown"></a>
### [`sfx_sample_knockdown`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_samples_f540_f580.asm#L6) `$F580-$F662`

*data*

Sample 0, $f580-$f663 (228 bytes, about 0.08 s): hit reaction $16, the knockdown ($2ce7). Each sample byte selects a timer B count (sfx_period_hi/lo). sfx_sample_irq ($311a) toggles the volume at each count, so the bytes are the lengths of the half waves.

<a id="sfx_sample_hit"></a>
### [`sfx_sample_hit`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_samples_f540_f580.asm#L37) `$F663-$F978`

*data*

Sample 1, $f663-$f979 (791 bytes, about 0.46 s): hit reactions $1a and $1b ($2cdc, $2cf2) and the bull hit ($13b7). Its first byte is the last byte of sample 0.
